description.value:
A lifetime of combat has left its mark, and taught you to endure. Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Rolling a 19 or 20 on a death saving throw restores 1 hit point to you. In addition, once between long rests, when you would be dropped to 0 hit points by damage that does not kill you outright, you may instead drop to 1 hit point.
